data.name: Julia
data.gender_notes: Julia is used as a female name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin Iulius, associated with iuvenis, 'young', or with the root for 'downy'. Its root is Latin iuvenis. A Roman family name; borne by early Christian saints. Julia is a Latin name meaning “Youthful; downy”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Julia expresses “Youthful; downy”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Latin Iulius, associated with iuvenis, 'young', or with the root for 'downy'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Julia total 17, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.
